t: The $(5)Frequency Card$() can hold, memorize and generate frequencies for interacting with machines. Its frequency can be set by placing it into a machine's frequency slot. Using it on any machine will set the frequency of that machine to whatever is set on the card. You can generate a random frequency by shift-right-clicking while holding the card.
$(5)频率卡$()可用于存储、记忆及生成频率，以实现与机器的交互。其频率可通过将其置入机器的频率插槽中进行设定。对任意机器使用该卡片，即可将该机器的频率设定为卡片当前所存频率。按住Shift键并右击手持的卡片，可生成一个随机频率。
